scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan. Could you please tell me the status of my application? Also, what is the interest rate that has been assigned to my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. The interest rate for your loan is 6.5%.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. What are the total costs associated with this loan? Additionally, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are $4,665.00. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Got it. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Fannie Mae. You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Could you also tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is and how it impacted my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 46%. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot explain how it impacted your application.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know. '<Satisfied>' The agent was clear and provided all the information I needed.
